title: Wahoo Sensor Dropout by Ride
app: COROS, Wahoo ELEMNT, TrainerRoad, Apple Fitness / HealthKit exports, Concept2 Logbook, Strava, Garmin Connect, and Zwift activity feeds via official APIs, FIT/CSV exports, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wahoo:workout
| stats sum(cadence_dropouts) as cadence_dropouts, sum(hr_dropouts) as hr_dropouts, avg(duration_min) as duration_min by workout_id head_unit
| where cadence_dropouts>2 OR hr_dropouts>2
| sort - cadence_dropouts - hr_dropouts
description: Uses Wahoo ELEMNT ride telemetry telemetry to monitor sensor stability during each recorded ride in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for head units or sensors that are quietly losing data quality, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Wahoo ELEMNT ride telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a weekly cadence.
visualization: Table of rides with cadence and heart-rate dropouts.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights sensor stability during each recorded ride so you can spot head units or sensors that are quietly losing data quality before it becomes annoying.
